summary: Microsoft Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central, shown as an everyday AI companion in a one-minute overview from May 2024. It covers marketing suggestions, sales quotes, orders and invoices, Power Automate flows, and finance tasks such as bank reconciliation and e-invoice matching.
overview:
A short promotional overview, published 2024-05-09, of how Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central is meant to help with everyday work. It frames Copilot as a companion that answers questions, guides onboarding, and saves time.

The video moves through three areas: marketing suggestions based on details already in Business Central, faster creation of sales quotes, orders and invoices, and finance support. Finance support covers bank statement reconciliation, matching purchase orders with e-invoices, and analysis views for data-driven decisions. It also mentions automating business processes with Power Automate flows. It stays at a high level and does not name specific objects or settings.
key_points: Copilot is presented as an everyday AI companion: users ask questions to find what they need and get guidance to onboard quickly.
Marketing suggestions are tailored to the brand using details already in Business Central, such as color, size and material.
Copilot is described as helping create sales quotes, orders and invoices faster.
Finance uses named: reconciling bank statements and matching purchase orders with e-invoices.
Analysis views are mentioned for making data-driven decisions.
Power Automate flows are mentioned for automating day-to-day business processes.
The video is a one-minute overview with no specific objects, setup steps or feature status given.
